description: Regional Long-Term Cycle Network (LTCN) (DOT-036) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport. The Regional Long-Term Cycling Network (RLTCN) is the aspirational active transport (cycling and walking) network for regional areas in WA. The dataset is used by DTMI for strategic planning. Each route has an assigned function (primary, secondary, local, transport trail or road cycling route). The network is aspirational and contains both existing and unbuilt routes. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport. Its tags are Active Transport, Bicycle Infrastructure, Cycling, Paths, Regional Long-Term Cycle Network. It offers 5 resource(s) in .ZIP SHAPEFILE, FILE GEODATABASE, MAPINFO MID/MIF, API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
